raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Design-domain geometry and aspect ratios",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 refers the domain to Fig. 3(left) and reference [64], without describing its outline or dimensions. In the readings below, x is the span direction, y the height direction, and z the width direction; their extents are L, H, and B.",
      "readings": [
        "Full rectangular prism with L:H:B = 3:1:1",
        "Full rectangular prism with L:H:B = 6:1:1",
        "Full rectangular prism with L:H:B = 3:1:0.5",
        "Stepped domain: full height over the first half-span and half height over the second half-span"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Absolute physical size of the domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "No physical beam dimensions are stated in Sec. 6.1.1. Absolute size matters because the specified Helmholtz radius is fixed at 0.1 m.",
      "readings": [
        "H = 0.5 m, with the selected aspect ratios",
        "H = 1 m, with the selected aspect ratios",
        "H = 2 m, with the selected aspect ratios"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Clamped end region",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The word 'cantilever' gives the general fixed-end intent, but Sec. 6.1.1 does not identify the supported faces, patches, or clamped length.",
      "readings": [
        "Clamp every node on the complete end face x = 0",
        "Clamp all nodes in the first element layer",
        "Clamp an end slab extending over 0 <= x <= 0.05L",
        "Clamp only two strips on x = 0: y <= H/4 and y >= 3H/4, across the full width"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Applied load location",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 gives no load coordinates or loaded boundary identification. The Fig. 3 caption supplies no loading description.",
      "readings": [
        "Free-end face center: (L, H/2, B/2)",
        "Midpoint of the lower free-end edge: (L, 0, B/2)",
        "Free-end corner: (L, 0, 0)",
        "A station inside the span, such as x = L/2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial extent and distribution of loading",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The cantilever subsection does not specify point, line, surface, patch, or body loading, or how distributed loading is assembled at nodes.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force at one node",
        "Equal nodal forces along an entire free-end edge",
        "Uniform physical line load along a free-end edge, with consistent nodal weights",
        "Uniform traction over the complete free-end face",
        "Uniform traction over a centered patch of height H/4 and width B/4",
        "Body force throughout the beam volume"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Applied load direction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No force or traction direction is stated for the cantilever in Sec. 6.1.1.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse loading in the negative y direction",
        "Transverse loading in the negative z direction",
        "Axial loading in the negative x direction",
        "Oblique transverse loading with equal negative y and z components"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Overall load amplitude",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 gives no numerical load amplitude. The reported compliances cannot determine it without the missing geometry and loading pattern. For a fixed loading pattern, an overall amplitude change only scales compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Total applied force resultant of 1 N",
        "Total applied force resultant of 1000 N",
        "Total applied force resultant of 1000000 N"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "Load-case count, simultaneity, and objective weights",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 does not state the number of load cases or their aggregation. The two-case average specified for the blade in Sec. 6.1.2 does not determine the cantilever loading.",
      "readings": [
        "One load case",
        "Two forces applied simultaneously in one load case",
        "Two independent transverse load cases with equal compliance weights",
        "Two independent transverse load cases with compliance weights 0.75 and 0.25"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Dependence of loading on design density",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (2) allows b(mu), but Sec. 6.1.1 does not specify whether its loading is design independent or includes density-dependent body forces.",
      "readings": [
        "Prescribed external loads independent of density, with no self-weight",
        "Body forces proportional to the unfiltered element densities mu",
        "Body forces proportional to the filtered element densities rho"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Fixed-solid and fixed-void regions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 does not identify passive cells or explicitly state that none exist, including material retained around supports and load application points.",
      "readings": [
        "Every domain element is designable; no passive regions",
        "One element layer at the clamp is fixed solid",
        "One element layer at the clamp and a pad beneath the load are fixed solid",
        "A prescribed void notch occupies the upper free-end quarter of the bounding box"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Meaning and normalization of the bound 0.5",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 calls 0.5 a mass-constraint upper bound without units or normalization. Eq. (1), however, defines an unnormalized volume sum and a dimensional total-volume bound. Treatment of any passive volume is also unstated.",
      "readings": [
        "Maximum material volume is 0.5 times the complete domain volume, counting passive solids",
        "Maximum designable material volume is 0.5 times the designable-region volume, excluding passive solids from the budget",
        "Use v_u = 0.5 m^3 literally in Eq. (1)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 prints the malformed expression '2.0 × 10^{1}1 N/m^2', leaving the exponent unclear.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 2.0e11 N/m^2, treating the trailing 1 as the second exponent digit",
        "E0 = 2.0e1 N/m^2, treating the trailing 1 as extraneous or multiplicative"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Helmholtz-filter boundary conditions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (3) specifies the differential operator, and Sec. 6.1.1 specifies r, but neither supplies boundary conditions.",
      "readings": [
        "Homogeneous Neumann conditions on every exterior face",
        "rho = 0 on every exterior face",
        "rho = 1 on the clamped face and homogeneous Neumann conditions elsewhere"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Helmholtz-filter discretization and density transfer",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (3) does not specify the discrete filter grid, mass treatment, or transfer between elementwise mu, the filter solution, and the element densities used in Eq. (4). The stated first-order hexahedra do not settle these filter choices.",
      "readings": [
        "Cell-centered finite-volume Helmholtz solve, producing one rho per design cell",
        "Nodal trilinear finite elements with a consistent mass matrix, followed by element averaging of rho",
        "Nodal trilinear finite elements with a row-sum lumped mass matrix, followed by element averaging of rho",
        "Filter on a separately refined grid and average the result back to design cells"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Element counts along each axis and refinement pattern",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 gives the total design-variable counts and uniform structured first-order hexahedra, but not Nx, Ny, Nz or the refinement pattern. Sec. 2 associates design variables with elements.",
      "readings": [
        "30x10x10, then 60x20x20, then 120x40x40 elements",
        "60x10x5, then 120x20x10, then 240x40x20 elements",
        "20x15x10, then 40x30x20, then 80x60x40 elements",
        "30x10x10, then 120x20x10, then 480x40x10 elements"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Hexahedral element integration and stabilization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 specifies first-order hexahedral elements but not their integration rule or stabilization.",
      "readings": [
        "Trilinear displacement elements with full 2x2x2 Gauss integration",
        "One-point reduced integration with hourglass stabilization",
        "Selective reduced integration of the volumetric stiffness contribution"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial design densities",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 6.1.1 nor the general optimization description gives the initial mu field. Initialization can affect the local minimum; Sec. 6.1.1 explicitly reports different local minima on the coarsest mesh.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform mu_i = 0.5",
        "Uniform mu_i = 0.25",
        "Small nonuniform perturbations about mu_i = 0.5, adjusted to satisfy the volume bound"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "IPOPT configuration beyond the reported convergence threshold",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1.1 names IPOPT and its convergence threshold but does not give the Hessian treatment, barrier strategy, problem scaling, or bound-handling options. These can change the path to a local minimum.",
      "readings": [
        "Exact Lagrangian Hessian, monotone barrier updates, and no problem scaling",
        "Limited-memory quasi-Newton Hessian, adaptive barrier updates, and automatic problem scaling"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PCG absolute stopping tolerance",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Algorithm 5, line 5, uses epsilon_abs in addition to the specified relative tolerance, but no numerical epsilon_abs is supplied for the cantilever.",
      "readings": [
        "epsilon_abs = 0, using only the relative criterion",
        "epsilon_abs = 1e-12",
        "epsilon_abs = 1e-8"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PCG iteration limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Algorithm 5, line 15, requires N_maxit, but Sec. 6.1.1 does not specify it.",
      "readings": [
        "N_maxit = 1000",
        "N_maxit = 10000",
        "No effective iteration cap before convergence"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "HYPRE AMG configuration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 5.2 and 6 identify HYPRE AMG, but do not specify coarsening, interpolation, smoothing, cycle settings, or treatment of elasticity modes.",
      "readings": [
        "Component-wise AMG with a V-cycle and symmetric Gauss-Seidel smoothing",
        "Component-wise AMG with a V-cycle and damped Jacobi smoothing",
        "Nodal elasticity AMG using rigid-body mode information and a W-cycle"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
